name: St. Francis of Assisi
description: Known for his humility, love of creation, care for the poor, and dedication to following Christ.

name: St. Thérèse of Lisieux
description: Known for her simplicity, humility, trust in God, and the spiritual path she called her little way.

name: St. Elizabeth Ann Seton
description: Known for her conversion to Catholicism, her dedication to charity, and her pioneering work in Catholic education in the United States.

name: St. John Neumann
description: Known for his dedication to Catholic education, his service as a bishop, and his work establishing and strengthening Catholic schools.

name: St. Kateri Tekakwitha
description: Known for her deep faith, perseverance through hardship, and devotion to Christ.

name: St. Katharine Drexel
description: Known for giving up a life of privilege to serve others, founding the Sisters of the Blessed Sacrament, and establishing schools and missions for Native American and African American communities.

name: St. Marianne Cope
description: Known for her compassionate service to people with leprosy in Hawaii and for dedicating her life to caring for those who were sick and marginalized.

name: St. Frances Xavier Cabrini
description: Known for her missionary work among immigrants, her service to the poor and sick, and founding schools and institutions throughout the United States.

name: St. Teresa of Calcutta
description: Known for her lifelong service to people experiencing extreme poverty and for founding the Missionaries of Charity.

name: St. Isidore of Seville
description: Known for his scholarship, teaching, writing, and defense of the faith. His extensive writings helped preserve and organize knowledge for generations.

name: St. Thomas Aquinas
description: Known for his profound theological and philosophical writings and for his dedication to seeking and explaining the truth of the Catholic faith.

name: St. Maximilian Kolbe
description: Known for his devotion to the Immaculate Virgin Mary, his missionary work, and his ultimate sacrifice for another prisoner at Auschwitz.

name: St. Francis de Sales
description: Known for his gentle approach to evangelization, his spiritual writings, and his dedication to teaching and guiding others in the faith.

name: St. Clare of Assisi
description: Known for her life of prayer, poverty, and devotion to Christ and for founding the Poor Clares.

name: St. John Bosco
description: Known for dedicating his life to educating and caring for young people, especially those who were poor or vulnerable.

name: St. Josephine Bakhita
patronage: Modern Sudan and human trafficking survivors
description: Known for her extraordinary journey from slavery to religious life and for her deep faith, forgiveness, and trust in God.

name: St. Juan Diego
description: Known for his humility and faith and for his role in the events surrounding the apparitions of Our Lady of Guadalupe.

name: St. Augustine of Hippo
description: Known for his conversion to Christianity, his profound theological writings, and his service as bishop of Hippo.

name: St. Monica
description: Known for her persistent prayer and faithful concern for her family, especially her son Augustine, whose conversion she prayed for over many years.

name: St. Ignatius of Loyola
description: Known for his conversion, spiritual exercises, missionary vision, and founding of the Society of Jesus.

name: St. Teresa of Ávila
description: Known for her deep life of prayer, spiritual writings, and work reforming the Carmelite religious life.

name: St. John of the Cross
description: Known for his mystical writings and his dedication to contemplative prayer and the reform of the Carmelite order.

name: St. Catherine of Siena
description: Known for her intense prayer life, service to the sick and poor, theological writings, and efforts for peace and unity in the Church.

name: St. Pio of Pietrelcina
description: Known for his life of prayer, ministry of reconciliation, spiritual guidance, and service to people who were suffering.

name: St. André Bessette
description: Known for his humble service as a religious brother, his devotion to St. Joseph, and his ministry of prayer and care for people who were sick.

name: St. Damien of Molokai
description: Known for dedicating his life to serving people with leprosy on Molokai and sharing their hardships as a missionary priest.

name: St. Óscar Romero
description: Known for his pastoral ministry, his concern for the poor and vulnerable, and his defense of human dignity and peace.

name: St. Patrick
description: Known for his missionary work in Ireland and for helping establish Christianity there.

name: St. Nicholas
description: Known for his generosity and care for people in need and remembered for his charitable acts as a bishop.

name: St. Lucy of Syracuse
description: Known for her steadfast faith and courage in remaining faithful to Christ despite persecution and martyrdom.

name: St. Agatha
description: Known for her courage and steadfast faith during persecution and martyrdom.

name: St. Lawrence
description: Known for his service as a deacon of Rome, his care for the poor, and his courage during persecution.

name: St. Martin de Porres
description: Known for his humble service to the poor and sick and for caring for people regardless of their background.

name: St. Rose of Lima
description: Known for her deep prayer life, humility, care for the poor, and dedication to Christ.

name: St. Bernadette Soubirous
description: Known for her humility and faith and for the apparitions of the Virgin Mary that she reported at Lourdes.

name: St. Francis Xavier
description: Known for his extensive missionary work in Asia and his dedication to bringing the Gospel to people in distant lands.

name: St. Marie-Marguerite d'Youville
description: Known for her dedication to caring for the poor, sick, elderly, widows, and orphans and for founding the Grey Nuns.

name: St. Benedict
description: Known for establishing the Benedictine way of monastic life and for his Rule, which has profoundly influenced Christian religious life.

name: St. Scholastica
description: Known as the twin sister of St. Benedict and for her life of prayer and dedication to God.

name: St. Anthony of Padua
description: Known for his powerful preaching, deep knowledge of Scripture, and dedication to teaching and serving others.

name: St. Dominic
description: Known for his preaching, dedication to the truth of the faith, and founding of the Order of Preachers.

name: St. Catherine Labouré
description: Known for her humble life as a Daughter of Charity and for the apparitions associated with the Miraculous Medal.

name: St. Elizabeth of Hungary
description: Known for giving generously to the poor and sick and for dedicating herself to a life of charitable service.

name: St. Vincent de Paul
description: Known for organizing extensive charitable works, caring for the poor, and founding communities dedicated to service.

name: St. Louise de Marillac
description: Known for organizing charitable service and for co-founding the Daughters of Charity with St. Vincent de Paul.

name: St. Camillus de Lellis
description: Known for dedicating his life to caring for the sick and founding a religious community devoted to healthcare.

name: St. Rita of Cascia
description: Known for her perseverance through difficult circumstances, her commitment to forgiveness, and her life of prayer as a wife, mother, widow, and religious.

name: St. Joan of Arc
description: Known for her extraordinary courage, deep faith, and role in the history of France. She believed she was called to help her country during a time of war.

name: St. George
description: Known in Christian tradition as a martyr who remained faithful to Christ despite persecution.

name: St. Christopher
description: Traditionally remembered as a Christian martyr and associated with carrying a child across a river, a story that became connected with his patronage of travelers.

name: St. Joseph
description: Known as the husband of Mary and foster father of Jesus, St. Joseph is remembered for his quiet faith, obedience, protection of his family, and work as a carpenter.

name: St. Joachim
description: Traditionally honored as the father of the Blessed Virgin Mary and the husband of St. Anne.

name: St. Anne
description: Traditionally honored as the mother of the Blessed Virgin Mary and grandmother of Jesus.

name: St. Martha
description: Known from the Gospel accounts as the sister of Mary and Lazarus and for welcoming Jesus into her home.

name: St. Mary Magdalene
description: A devoted disciple of Jesus who witnessed his crucifixion and became one of the first witnesses to the Resurrection.

name: St. Thomas More
description: Known for his public service, legal scholarship, devotion to his family, and willingness to suffer martyrdom rather than act against his conscience.

name: St. John Henry Newman
description: Known for his conversion to Catholicism, theological and educational work, and writings on faith, conscience, and the pursuit of truth.

name: St. Gregory the Great
description: Known for his leadership as pope, his writings on pastoral care, his missionary efforts, and his contributions to the development of Christian worship.

name: St. Leo the Great
description: Known for his leadership as pope, defense of Catholic teaching, and efforts to preserve unity and peace in the Church.

name: St. Jerome
description: Known for his biblical scholarship and for translating Scripture into Latin in the work that became known as the Vulgate.

name: St. Ambrose
description: Known for his preaching and teaching, care for the poor, theological writings, and influence as bishop of Milan.

name: St. Lawrence Justinian
description: Known for his life of prayer, pastoral service, reform, and leadership as the first patriarch of Venice.

name: St. Philip Neri
description: Known for his joyful approach to Christian life, dedication to young people, ministry of confession, and founding of the Congregation of the Oratory.

name: St. Charles Borromeo
description: Known for his leadership during the Catholic reform of the sixteenth century, his work in seminaries and catechesis, and his service to the poor.

name: St. John Vianney
description: Known for his devoted pastoral ministry as parish priest of Ars, his preaching, prayer, and dedication to the Sacrament of Reconciliation.

name: St. Alphonsus Liguori
description: Known for his theological writings, preaching, concern for ordinary people, and founding of the Redemptorists.

name: St. Peter Claver
description: Known for his ministry to enslaved people arriving in Cartagena and for dedicating his life to serving people who were suffering and marginalized.

name: St. Thomas the Apostle
description: Known as one of the Twelve Apostles and remembered for his honest struggle to believe in the Resurrection before encountering the risen Christ.

name: St. James the Greater
description: One of the Twelve Apostles and one of the first disciples called by Jesus. He was among the apostles present at important moments in Christ's ministry.

name: St. Peter the Apostle
description: One of the Twelve Apostles and a leading figure among the disciples of Jesus. After denying Christ during his Passion, Peter was restored and became a prominent witness to the Gospel.

name: St. Paul the Apostle
description: Known for his dramatic conversion to Christ and extensive missionary work, through which he helped spread the Gospel throughout the ancient Mediterranean world.

name: St. Andrew the Apostle
description: One of the first disciples called by Jesus and the brother of St. Peter. He is remembered for bringing others to Christ and for his missionary witness.

name: St. Matthew the Apostle
description: Traditionally identified as the tax collector called by Jesus to become one of the Twelve Apostles and associated with the Gospel according to Matthew.

name: St. Mark the Evangelist
description: Traditionally associated with the Gospel according to Mark and remembered as an important early Christian missionary and evangelist.

name: St. Luke the Evangelist
description: Traditionally identified as a physician and companion of St. Paul and associated with the Gospel according to Luke and the Acts of the Apostles.

name: St. Bartholomew the Apostle
description: One of the Twelve Apostles, traditionally identified with Nathanael in the Gospel of John and remembered for his missionary witness.

name: St. Philip the Apostle
description: One of the Twelve Apostles who followed Jesus and brought others to meet him. He is remembered for his witness to Christ and missionary discipleship.

name: St. Cyril of Alexandria
description: A bishop and major theologian of the early Church who played an important role in defending Christian teaching about the identity of Jesus Christ.

name: St. Cyril
description: A missionary and scholar who, together with his brother Methodius, helped evangelize the Slavic peoples and contributed to the development of written language for their mission.

name: St. Methodius
description: A missionary bishop who worked with his brother Cyril to evangelize the Slavic peoples and translate Christian texts for their communities.

name: St. Teresa Benedicta of the Cross
description: A philosopher who converted to Catholicism, became a Carmelite nun, and was killed at Auschwitz during the Holocaust. She is remembered for her intellectual life, faith, and witness.

name: St. Faustina Kowalska
description: A Polish religious sister whose spiritual writings and devotion to Divine Mercy became influential throughout the Catholic Church.

name: St. Rose Philippine Duchesne
description: A French religious sister who came to the United States and dedicated much of her life to education and missionary work.

name: St. Peter Julian Eymard
description: A French priest who dedicated his ministry to promoting love and devotion to the Eucharist and founded religious communities devoted to Eucharistic life.

name: St. John Fisher
description: An English bishop and scholar who remained faithful to his Catholic convictions and was executed during the English Reformation.

name: St. Josemaría Escrivá
description: A Spanish priest and founder of Opus Dei who emphasized seeking holiness through ordinary daily life, work, family, and personal responsibilities.

name: St. Isaac Jogues
description: A French Jesuit missionary who served among Indigenous peoples in North America and was martyred during his missionary work.

name: St. René Goupil
description: A French Jesuit lay missionary and surgeon who accompanied missionaries in North America and was martyred while serving the mission.

name: St. Jean de Brébeuf
description: A French Jesuit missionary who served among Indigenous peoples in North America and was martyred during his missionary work.

name: St. Andrew Kim Taegon
description: The first Korean-born Catholic priest, who was martyred during a period of persecution of Christians in Korea.

name: St. Paul Miki
description: A Japanese Jesuit who was martyred with other Christians during persecution in Japan and remained committed to proclaiming the Gospel.

name: St. Charles Lwanga
description: A Ugandan Christian and catechist who encouraged other young Christians during persecution and was martyred for his faith.

name: St. Daniel Comboni
description: An Italian bishop and missionary who devoted his life to evangelization and service in Africa and founded a missionary congregation.

name: St. Francis Xavier Khang
description: A Vietnamese priest and martyr who remained faithful to his Catholic ministry during persecution in Vietnam.

name: St. Augustine Zhao Rong
description: A Chinese priest and martyr who is remembered with the many Chinese Christians who gave their lives for the Catholic faith.

name: St. Andrew Dũng-Lạc
description: A Vietnamese priest and martyr who represents the many Christians who suffered persecution for the Catholic faith in Vietnam.

name: St. Nicholas Owen
description: An English Jesuit lay brother and skilled carpenter who built hiding places for priests during periods of persecution and was eventually martyred.

name: St. Mark Ji Tianxiang
description: A Chinese Catholic physician and martyr who remained faithful to Christ despite persecution and a lifelong struggle with opium addiction.

name: St. Alfonso Navarrete
description: A Spanish Dominican missionary who served in Japan and was martyred during the persecution of Christians.

name: St. Pedro Calungsod
description: A young Filipino catechist and missionary who accompanied Jesuit missionaries to the Marianas and was killed while serving the mission.
